caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a small, sculpted figurine of a squirrel. The figurine is depicted in a side profile, sitting upright on its haunches with its bushy tail curving upward behind its back. The primary color of the squirrel's body is a worn, pale greyish white with subtle spots of wear or patina, revealing hints of brown underneath. The inner ear and nose areas are lightly accented with red. The squirrel is holding an object close to its mouth with both forepaws, though the object itself is indistinct and blends with the hand, suggesting it might be eating. The base of the figurine is oval and painted green, imitating the appearance of grass. The tail is predominantly green with visible veining to simulate fur or leafy texture. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of an off-white or beige color, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Squirrel
